subject: [PATCH v4 02/19] selftests/mm: skip collapse_compound_extreme() where the PMD is too large

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch as sensible due to PMD size limitations on 64 KiB page sizes. Added Acked-by tag.

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the selftests/mm module, specifically with the collapse_compound_extreme() function. The function builds a PTE table for distinct compound pages by cycling through THPs and requires hpage_pmd_nr PMD-order allocations. However, this can fail for large PMD sizes due to allocation limitations. To mitigate this, the patch skips the case where the PMD is larger than 32M.
